說明: 《畫海人》劇情動畫（開場、各島的進場、各章結尾）用的插圖。名稱要和 畫海人/js/islands.js 的 CINEMA 裡的 img 一樣。畫面是正方形，主體放中間，下方三分之一留給字幕。

style.scene: Anime film still, hand-painted background art with soft painterly brushwork and rich environmental detail. Medieval European fantasy setting. Muted, slightly dark color grading: desaturated slate grey, deep sea blue and moss green in the shadows and skies; warm amber-gold light comes only from the light sources that the description below mentions (for example a lantern, a candle, a hearth or a sunset), with soft bloom and long shadows. Atmospheric haze, quiet melancholic mood, cinematic composition. One single continuous illustration filling the whole square frame, one unified scene from top to bottom, with the main subject in the upper-middle. Show only what the description below asks for.
style.negative: text, letters, words, readable writing, signature, watermark, logo, border, frame, speech bubble, manga panel, photograph, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, chibi, oversaturated neon colors, bright cheerful daylight, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, deformed, bad anatomy, extra fingers, extra limbs, missing fingers, duplicate figures, collage, split image, mixed indoor and outdoor scene, gore, blood, modern objects, guns, cars, electric lights, asian architecture, paper lanterns, pagoda, kimono
style.scene_people: Only the people mentioned in the description appear, drawn in clean anime style with crisp line art and cel shading.
style.scene_empty: The scene is completely empty of people: no humans, no figures and no human silhouettes anywhere in the picture.
style.scene_hands: Only the hands and forearms mentioned are visible, reaching in from the edge of the frame and naturally attached to arms; no faces and no other people.
style.scene_empty_lead: Pure environment art with no characters: an uninhabited place where no person, figure or traveler appears anywhere, not even a tiny one in the distance.
